description.text: Starter Set VMAX Venusaur, a 60-card deck released on 4 December 2020 with Blastoise's, each with two copies of its Pokémon VMAX. Venusaur VMAX's Forest Storm deals 30 damage for each Grass Energy on all of its player's Pokémon, and G-Max Bloom deals 210 and heals 30. Both decks have a Boss's Orders and four Quick Ball. A playmat, a coin, damage counters and markers and a player's guide came with it. The VMAX Battle Triple Starter Set of the same day held the Charizard VMAX, Venusaur VMAX and Blastoise VMAX decks, four holo promos (Genesect, Heatran, Suicune and Lugia), its own playmat and a card box, a Christmas gift for families.
